previous.observation: Root actually viewed native returned raw, complete white/black QA, coil paired2x and eyes2x, original canonical guide, original F863 full, R25 full/hair-only, user turns-only and previous07 white. Existing body, correct low imageRIGHT/anatomicalLEFT bead attachment, two black cap leaves, original bent versus hanging arms/crossed legs/visible crop remain. Material silver sheen is reduced, but coil still reads as compact stacked closed mint faces with narrow gray return slits and old circular hook tip, rather than substantial broad gray opaque front/return folds and tapered continuous hair ribbon of latest user reference. Not rejected for fixed hole count, horizontal axis or mint area ratio; actual topology/returns/tip remain unresolved. New eyes also introduce clearly separate black central pupils inside shaded gray irises, departing from the current single-charcoal-fill eye basis and original08 simple eyes. Do not adopt or bind; fresh independent actual view pending. Next hypothesis should remove old solid-cone target/R25 cone image from structural guidance rather than stack more negative text. No dynamics/user approval.
